title: Document guardian launch hash cycles and the missing authenticated entry
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Establishes two concrete dependency cycles in a proposed direct-literal native-guardian launch and identifies the missing authenticated external entry/final-pin transport. The source argument separates the checked candidate-document identity from the exact-shell identity and follows the actual request/configuration and CAPTURE grant/policy relations.

This is a completed scoped obstruction audit. Complete installation and the full combined-source gate remain OPEN. It disproves the proposed direct-literal topological construction, not all permitted shell programs or the existence of SHA256 fixed points. The next task is actual authenticated entry-owner construction with an unchanged fixed candidate/shell, genuine separately issued original inputs, immutable derived-byte publication and authenticated final-pin consumption. No executable correction or protocol/model amendment is claimed.

This is an inert source-audit archive, complete within the scope stated here and prepared Ready for review. Independent AI source analysis and a contribution-author source/criterion audit do not constitute human review, proof-kernel acceptance, runtime admission or a speedup claim. The original predicates, independent oracles, modes, reservations and error/cleanup semantics remain unchanged.
